title: 3' Azide labelling with TdT
author: Benjamin Emert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qnmdvc6

steps.title: Prepare TdT reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the following in a nuclease‑free tube: 10× Terminal Transferase buffer, 2.5 mM CoCl₂, 400 µM template oligo, 10 mM N⁶(6‑azido)hexyl‑3′‑dATP, recombinant TdT (20 U/µL), and nuclease‑free water to the desired final volume (scale‑up as needed).

steps.title: Incubate reaction overnight
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermal cycler set to 37 °C and incubate overnight; set the cycler lid temperature for 12:00:00 as indicated.

steps.title: Add precipitation reagents
steps.instruction: Add 1/10th total reaction volume of 3 M sodium acetate, then add 3 × the reaction volume of 200‑proof ethanol to precipitate the azide‑labeled oligo. If removal of excess N⁶‑(6‑azido)hexyl‑3′‑dATP is desired, add 1/2 × reaction volume of 7.5 M ammonium acetate (optional).

steps.title: Cold precipitation
steps.instruction: Place the mixture at –80 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00) to complete precipitation; incubation at –20 °C or longer at –80 °C is also acceptable.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 10 minutes at 16,000 × g.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 70 % ethanol to the pellet, then centrifuge for 2–5 minutes at 16,000 × g (00:02:00).

steps.title: Remove wash supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the ethanol supernatant, avoiding disturbance of the pellet.

steps.title: Final quick spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 16,000 × g (00:01:00) to collect any residual liquid from the lid and walls.

steps.title: Dry the pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the remaining supernatant and dry the pellet either under vacuum or by air drying.

steps.title: Resuspend in water
steps.instruction: Add 1.8 µL nuclease‑free water to the dried pellet, let it sit at room temperature for ≥20 minutes (00:20:00) to dissolve. Note that ~10 % loss may occur; precise concentration can be measured if needed, but beware of residual dATP.

steps.title: Store azide‑modified oligo
steps.instruction: Aliquot the azide‑modified oligo and store at –20 °C indefinitely.
